subject: Learning Methods
title: Writing as Teaching
description: A quick win: understand Writing as Teaching.

hook.text: William Zinsser said: writing is thinking on paper. When you write to explain, you discover what you understand.

buildup.text: Writing an explanation forces linear coherence. Each sentence must follow the last.

discovery.text: Blog posts, study summaries, and social media posts about material you're learning all activate the teaching effect.

twist.text: Public writing raises the stakes. Knowing others will read it triggers the same accountability as the protege effect.

climax.text: Start a learning journal or blog. Write a short explanation of each topic you study. The writing is the deepest study.

punchline.text: Write to explain. The writing itself is the learning.

quiz.question: Why is writing an especially effective form of teaching?
options: Typing speed is faster than speaking speed
It forces linear coherence, making gaps in logic visible
Written explanations can be longer than verbal ones
